sloka: स भार्यावचनम् श्रुत्वा शाटीमाच्छाद्य दुश्छदाम् ।स प्रतिष्ठत पन्थानम् यत्र रामनिवेशनम् ॥२-३२-३२॥
transliteration: sa bhāryāvacanam śrutvā śāṭīmācchādya duśchadām ।sa pratiṣṭhata panthānam yatra rāmaniveśanam ॥2-32-32॥

translations.english: At the words of his wife, Trijata took the path to Rama's palace, having wrapped himself with a torn upper garment .
